name: CountBoard
tagline: 把考试 / 高考倒计时做成桌面磁贴，一眼看到还剩几天
taglineEn: Desktop countdown tiles for exams and important dates
description: CountBoard 是一个开源的桌面日程倒计时工具，把「高考还剩多少天」「下次月考还有几天」做成一块贴在桌面上的磁贴。磁贴提供亚克力与毛玻璃两种质感，既可以嵌进桌面（跟着桌面显示、不挡操作），也可以做成独立窗体并设置置顶；双击磁贴直接修改或删除日程，右键可以新建。提醒支持「每天固定时间」和「每隔一段时间」两种方式，计时还能选普通模式（24 小时内算一天）或紧迫模式（24 小时内算零天）。体积小、免安装依赖，放在教室电脑上很合适。
descriptionEn: CountBoard is an open-source desktop countdown tool that turns questions like “how many days until the exam” into a tile pinned to the desktop. Tiles offer acrylic and frosted-glass looks, can be embedded in the desktop or used as a separate always-on-top window, and can be edited or deleted with a double-click (right-click to add). Reminders can repeat daily at a fixed time or at intervals, and the countdown can use normal mode (a day counts within 24 hours) or urgent mode (within 24 hours counts as zero days). It is small, needs no runtime install, and suits classroom PCs.
author: Gaoyongxian666
